title: AMD amends wafer supply agreement with GlobalFoundries

sources.quote: On January 28, 2019, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (the “Company”) entered into a seventh amendment (the “Seventh Amendment”) to the Wafer Supply Agreement with GLOBALFOUNDRIES Inc. (“GF”).

explain: AMD, which spun off its factories as GlobalFoundries in 2009, agreed to new yearly wafer purchase targets and pricing with GF for 2019-2021 while gaining freedom to make its newest 7nm chips elsewhere (at TSMC). AMD pays GF for wafers, and pays a penalty if it misses the targets. Dollar amounts were not disclosed.
